patch_description:
This program is a crossover between the provided ansatz variants that performed best in prior runs. It keeps the fixed training loop, feature map, and measurement layout, but replaces only the EVOLVE-BLOCK ANSATZ_SPEC with a combined motif:

- Lightweight symmetry-grouped local RY rotations (corners/edges/center) to keep parameter sharing and inductive bias.
- A parameterized lattice entanglement layer implemented with shared CRZ gates on all grid edges (one shared "crz_grid" parameter). This replaces the fixed CZ backbone and gives the optimizer continuous control over entanglement strength while respecting adjacency constraints.
- Three-qubit ZZZ motifs split by geometric category (zzz_row, zzz_col, zzz_diag) so the ansatz can specialize to rows, columns, and diagonals (motif discovery).
- Doubly-controlled CCRZ phases on the two diagonals to complement diagonal ZZZs.
- Shared post-phase RZ rotations grouped by symmetry (corner/edge/center) and an additional shared RX rotation by symmetry (corner/edge/center) to increase expressivity without exploding parameter count.

The design targets the favorable expressivity/parameter-efficiency balance seen in earlier high-performing variants: 14 parameters per block, yielding 84 total parameters (with N_UPLOADS=3 and N_REPEATS=2). The choice of shared parameters and geometric splitting encourages line detection motifs while keeping parameter count moderate. Other parts of the program outside the EVOLVE-BLOCK are preserved to maintain identical inputs/outputs and training behavior.
